- After `setName`, notify sets `userName.dirtyCause='user.name'`. When `logic.values.greeting` is accessed, it evaluates `userName` (reducer? no, userName is derived). Wait `userName` is a derived selector (dep `user.name`). When it re-evaluates, `meta.dirtyCause` is already `user.name` (from notify), so we keep it. Then `userName` propagate (derived) sets `greeting.dirtyCause='selector:userName'`. When `greeting` re-evaluates, keeps `selector:userName`. Test should still pass.
